summary.goal: Wire Planner to emit PlanQualitySignal to Tuner when an ideation-sourced plan is approved. This is the downstream quality signal that closes the feedback loop.

acceptance_criteria.description: On plan approval, check plan.source.type === 'ideation' and plan.source.session_id exists
Gather questions_asked, questions_hard_blocking from plan questions
Set versions_before_approval from the approved version number
Gather improvements_suggested, improvements_accepted from version improvements
Count blocks_received from plan understanding._blocks
blocks_mapped_to_steps = 0 for v1 (step-level source tracking deferred)
Fire-and-forget submission to Tuner (log warning on failure, don't block approval)
Signal NOT emitted for manually-created plans (only ideation-sourced)

steps.title: Add PlanQualitySignal emission to approve handler
steps.description: Extend packages/planner/src/api/handlers/workflow.ts approve handler to emit PlanQualitySignal when approving ideation-sourced plans

acceptance_criteria.description: After version status set to 'approved', check plan.source?.type === 'ideation' && plan.source.session_id
If check passes, gather signal data and call tunerClient.submitPlanQualitySignal()
Fire-and-forget: .catch(e => console.warn('[planner] Failed to submit plan quality signal:', e.message))
Approval succeeds even if Tuner submission fails

steps.title: Gather questions data
steps.description: Query storage for plan questions and count total questions and hard-blocking questions

acceptance_criteria.description: const questions = storage.listQuestionsByPlan(planId)
questions_asked = questions.length
questions_hard_blocking = questions.filter(q => q.blocking_level === 'hard_block').length

steps.title: Gather version and improvements data
steps.description: Set versions_before_approval from version number, gather improvements from version

acceptance_criteria.description: versions_before_approval = approvedVersion.version
const improvements = version.improvements ?? []
improvements_suggested = improvements.length
improvements_accepted = improvements.filter(i => i.status === 'accepted').length
blocks_received = version.understanding?._blocks?.length ?? 0
blocks_mapped_to_steps = 0 for v1 (deferred to later)

architecture.note: Step-level source tracking deferred to later phase

steps.title: Calculate time to approval
steps.description: Compute time_to_approval_seconds from plan creation to approval timestamp

acceptance_criteria.description: If plan.created_at and approval timestamp available: time_to_approval_seconds = (approval_ts - created_ts) / 1000
Otherwise: time_to_approval_seconds = null

steps.title: Initialize TunerClient in planner
steps.description: In packages/planner or src/, initialize TunerClient (if not already) and make available to handlers

acceptance_criteria.description: import { TunerClient } from '@planner/tuner'; or getDefaultTunerClient() if available
TunerClient initialized with TUNER_URL from env (or default)
Available in workflow handler context

architecture.pattern: Use existing tuner client if available, otherwise create

steps.title: Test PlanQualitySignal emission
steps.description: Integration tests verifying signal emission on approval of ideation-sourced plans

acceptance_criteria.description: Ideation-sourced plan approval emits PlanQualitySignal with correct data
Manually-created plan approval does NOT emit signal
Signal includes questions_asked, versions_before_approval, blocks_received
Approval succeeds when Tuner is unreachable (fire-and-forget)
